bind_ip.description: IPv4 address to bind to (leave empty to bind to all interfaces).

bind_ipv6.description: IPv6 address to bind to (leave empty to disable IPv6).

port.description: TCP port for plain-text IRC connections.

ssl_port.description: TCP port for SSL/TLS-encrypted IRC connections.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files (IRC sessions, errors, etc.) are stored.

pid_file.description: Path to PID file for process management.

allow_plaintext.description: Allow plaintext (non-SSL) connections to bip itself (not recommended for production).

users.description: List of IRC users (each with their own credentials, network defaults, and settings).

name.description: Unique username for login (used in client connections).

password.description: Password for user authentication (plain text; consider hashing via external auth plugin).

username.description: Username (ident) to send to IRC servers (if not set, defaults to user name).

nicks.description: List of preferred nicks (in fallback order).

default_server.description: Primary IRC server to connect to by default (e.g., 'irc.libera.chat').

default_port.description: Port for default IRC server connection.

default_ssl.description: Connect to default server using SSL by default.

default_password.description: Password for default IRC server (e.g., NickServ auth).

default_channels.description: List of channels to auto-join on the default server.

use_ssl.description: Force SSL for *all* server connections for this user.

ssl_verify.description: Verify SSL certificates of IRC servers (set to false to allow self-signed).

ssl_cafile.description: Path to CA bundle for SSL verification (optional).

ssl_capath.description: Path to directory with CA certificates for SSL verification (optional).

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds for IRC servers.

reconnect_delay.description: Seconds to wait before reconnecting after disconnect.

max_history_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to store per channel/query per user.

max_history_bytes.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of history per channel/query (1 MiB default).

history_persist.description: Persist history across restarts (recommended for playback).

autoquery.description: Automatically open a query window when someone messages this user.

autojoin.description: Automatically join channels listed in default_channels.

flood_protection.description: Enable rate-limiting for outgoing messages to IRC servers.

irc_debug.description: Log raw IRC protocol traffic (use only for debugging).

always_away.description: Set user status to away on connect.

away_message.description: Away message to use if always_away is true.

network_aliases.description: Optional named network definitions for reuse by users.

name.description: Alias name (e.g., 'libera') to reference in user configs.

password.description: Optional network password (e.g., SASL or server auth).
